name: 85122 · Casa Grande, AZ
findings: ZIP 85122 (Casa Grande) has 110 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85122 (Casa Grande) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85122 (Casa Grande) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 39% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
